subject: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Preview encoder SLA: need safety-net playbook for Grace pilot

Team —

Quick context: Grace Systems is moving our new preview encoder (encoder-v2-preview) into a staged pilot next week. They’ve asked for explicit commitments around availability/latency during the preview, but Legal and I think we should avoid baking long-term SLA changes for a preview.

Request: can we draft a short "availability safety-net" playbook that covers the following?
- Temporary floor on availability (explicitly documented) and how we measure it for the pilot window
- Canary rollout gates and traffic shaping thresholds
- Automatic fallback/route-to-stable-model behavior and KV cache considerations
- Rollback triggers (error budget burn, >x% increased p95 requests)
- Monitoring hooks that Laura can share with the customer (read-only dashboard + alerting)

I started a draft (see drive link) and put an initial proposed floor of 99.8% for the pilot window (2 weeks). Marcus/Rishi — need your input on feasibility and exact metrics we can promise. Laura — you’ll need the monitoring exports and a communication timeline for the customer.

Will loop Legal once engineering signs off.

Thanks,
Neha
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Mira Chen <mira@gracesys.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@gracesys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook

Hi Mira / Michael —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the encoder-v2 preview. Per our call this morning, attaching a short playbook we plan to follow during your staged pilot. High-level items:
- Temporary availability floor: 99.8% across the pilot window (2 weeks), measured on a per-region basis. This is a temporary, pilot-only operational commitment, not a permanent SLA change.
- Canary gates at 5% / 25% / 60% traffic windows with automated health checks (latency, error rate, memory pressure).
- Auto-fallback: requests that hit timeout/circuit-breaker will route to encoder-v1-stable. KV cache priming will be shared to minimize cold-start spikes.
- Rollback triggers: sustained p95 latency >250ms for >15 minutes or error rate >2% for OR consistent resource saturation in serving cluster.
- Observability: read-only Grafana dashboard + daily digest for pilot owners.

Attachments: safety-net-playbook-v1.pdf (draft), kb-sla-metrics-202608.csv (supporting data).

Would you be comfortable with this approach? If yes, we’ll formalize a very short pilot addendum (DocuSign) and proceed.

Best,
Olga
Senior TAM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: safety-net-playbook-v1.pdf (draft, 6 pages)
Attachment: kb-sla-metrics-202608.csv (sample telemetry for similar previews)
From: Mira Chen <mira@gracesys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@gracesys.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook

Olga —

Thanks for the concise plan. High level we like the safety-net approach; a couple of asks from our side before we sign: 
1) Can you add an explicit remediation SLA when you miss the temporary floor? For example, committed postmortem within 48 hours and targeted mitigation timeline for the pilot (we'd prefer something like a 72-hour mitigation plan).
2) For the auto-fallback, can you confirm whether requests routed to encoder-v1 will preserve output schema and metadata we rely on? We need a compatibility guarantee to avoid downstream ingestion breaks.
3) We will want the Grafana link and daily digest to include raw p95/p99 values and request counts per 5m window.

If you can add the remediation bullets and confirm compatibility, Grace is ready to proceed with a signed pilot addendum.

—Mira
Sr. Product Ops, Grace Systems
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook

Neha/Olga —

Quick technical confirms from SRE:
- 99.8% temporary floor over 2 weeks is feasible if we keep the canary cadence and automated fallback. It buys us headroom compared to the GA SLA and avoids permanent SLA changes.
- Auto-fallback to encoder-v1 will preserve output schema for core fields. There are two optional metadata fields in v2 that won't be present in v1; we'll include a compatibility flag in the payload so your downstreams can tolerate missing fields. We'll add a note to the playbook.
- Remediation: we can commit to a 48-hour initial incident report and a mitigation plan target of 72 hours for pilot-impacting outages. For regressions that require code change, timeline depends on severity but we'll include a priority response window in the addendum.

I also recommend adding an explicit "circuit-breaker cool-down" (5m) and a manual rollback button on the deployment page for the pilot. Marcus — can you confirm the UX for the manual rollback?

Rishi
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook

Confirmed — deployment UX will include a one-click rollback to encoder-v1 with confirmation and an automatic purge of the preview KV cache to avoid cross-traffic. Manual rollback will be logged and generate an alert to the on-call SRE. Adding the cool-down window and the compatibility flag to the payload is straightforward; I'll drop updated snippets into the playbook.

I attached a small CSV with typical latency distributions so Grace has an expectation baseline.

Attachment: kb-sla-metrics-202608.csv

Marcus
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Mira Chen <mira@gracesys.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@gracesys.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook — final addendum

Mira / Michael —

Thanks for the quick turn. We updated the playbook with the remediation commitments and compatibility notes Rishi/Marcus outlined. Next steps if you agree:
1) I'll send a very short pilot addendum for signature (DocuSign) — it will include the temporary floor (99.8%), remediation timelines (48h incident report, 72h mitigation target), and list of rollback triggers.
2) We’ll provision the read-only Grafana link and start the daily digest during canary rollover.

Attached: safety-net-playbook-v1.pdf (final draft), docsign-preview-addendum.pdf (prepped for signature).

Please reply with a one-line approval and I’ll send DocuSign.

Best,
Olga
Senior TAM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: safety-net-playbook-v1.pdf
Attachment: docsign-preview-addendum.pdf (DocuSign ready)
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@gracesys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Mira Chen <mira@gracesys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T17:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preview encoder: proposed availability safety-net & launch playbook — final addendum

Olga —

One-line approval from Grace: we agree to the pilot addendum and the temporary availability floor and remediation commitments. Please send the DocuSign link and we’ll countersign. Looking forward to the canary next week.

Thanks,
Michael
Sr. Eng Manager, Grace Systems
